dmi_notes.board_name: This board currently reports INVALID and is not useful as a hard identity gate.

observations.vpc2004_fan_mode: Writing 4 succeeds at sysfs level but immediately reads back as 0 on this machine, so it is status-only until DKMS fan support is added.
observations.thinkpad_acpi_fan: Reports 4 RPM and is not trusted as Legion fan telemetry.

capabilities.name: Fn+Q power mode switch
capabilities.status: source-derived; live firmware profile surface present
capabilities.current_owner: firmware platform_profile plus legionctl policy reassertion
capabilities.planned_owner: WMI event listener after DKMS/event surface is proven
capabilities.notes: Hardware toggles Lenovo thermal/power mode. This package currently enforces max-power on AC and low-power/balanced on battery, but does not yet consume Fn+Q WMI events.

capabilities.name: Fn+R refresh-rate toggle
capabilities.planned_owner: userspace hotkey action after event and panel-mode capture
capabilities.notes: johnfan reference contains an ACPI hook and action script, but marks the driver event path unfinished and hardcodes panel/output values. Local implementation must enumerate this panel's real modes instead of assuming 165/60 Hz.

capabilities.name: Fn+Space keyboard lighting/RGB cycle
capabilities.status: expected Legion behavior; not verified on this machine
capabilities.planned_owner: read-only event/controller discovery first; RGB control later if needed
capabilities.notes: Bolekjar exposes keyboard feature/light WMI methods and RGB controller code; this repo has not yet captured the actual Fn+Space event path on 82WQ.

capabilities.name: Fn+Esc Fn-lock toggle
capabilities.planned_owner: status/control only if a stable sysfs or WMI surface is observed
capabilities.notes: johnfan documents Fn-lock support. It is not part of the current power stability target.

capabilities.name: Real fan RPM/temperature telemetry
capabilities.current_owner: none; thinkpad_acpi fan data is ignored
capabilities.notes: Bolekjar hwmon reads CPU/GPU/SYS fan RPM and temperatures via Legion WMI methods. This is the first DKMS target.

capabilities.name: Fan max/full-speed and fan curve control
capabilities.planned_owner: explicit commands only after telemetry is trusted
capabilities.notes: VPC2004 fan_mode is ineffective here. Fan writes should not be added until read-only telemetry proves the DKMS path is correct.

capabilities.name: Hybrid graphics / G-Sync / MUX state
capabilities.planned_owner: explicit utility command, never automatic AC policy
capabilities.notes: null-dev exposes hybrid graphics through a WMI method; Bolekjar exposes G-Sync and iGPU-mode methods. These are reboot-risk features and stay out of the first power policy layer.

capabilities.name: Panel overdrive
capabilities.planned_owner: explicit status/control only after method support is confirmed
capabilities.notes: Bolekjar WMI gamezone exposes OD status/set methods.

capabilities.name: Win-key lock and touchpad toggle
capabilities.notes: Bolekjar exposes Win-key and touchpad enable/disable WMI methods. These do not affect CPU/GPU performance policy.

capabilities.name: Battery conservation / rapid charge / charge mode events
capabilities.notes: johnfan documents conservation/rapid charge; Bolekjar has charge-mode WMI event handling. This remains separate from AC performance enforcement.
